literature.abstract: Cilofexor is a selective farnesoid X receptor (FXR) agonist in development for the treatment of nonalcoholic steatohepatitis and primary sclerosing cholangitis. Our objective was to evaluate potential drug-drug interactions of cilofexor as a victim and as a perpetrator.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 肝纖維化研究顯示凝血酶可活化 PAR-2 促進肝星狀細胞增殖，理論上 thrombin 抑制或可減緩膽管周圍纖維化進展。然此機轉為高度推測性，目前無任何 PSC/SSC 動物模型或人體研究支持 dabigatran 應用於膽管硬化症。
凝血酶抑制與脂質代謝（LDL/VLDL 升高、HDL 降低）無已知直接機轉關聯。此外疾病名稱標記「obsolete」代表 ontology 已棄用此分類，研究目標本身存在定義問題，不建議以廢棄疾病術語進行再利用評估。
低 HDL 血症主要由 ABCA1/APOA1 功能缺陷或 CETP 過活躍驅動，與凝血酶路徑無直接關聯。高 TxGNN 分數可能反映知識圖譜中脂質代謝節點與凝血節點的間接連結（如心血管共病），但缺乏直接生物學支持。
HoFH 由 LDL 受體雙等位基因功能喪失突變引起，治療核心為降低 LDL-C（statin/ezetimibe/PCSK9 抑制劑/lomitapide/lipoprotein apheresis）。雖 HoFH 患者心血管風險極高、可能合併抗凝需求，但此為「共病處置」而非以 dabigatran 治療 HoFH 本身。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 凝血酶為強效血小板活化劑（PAR-1/PAR-4），理論上 DTI 可減少凝血酶誘發的血小板顆粒釋放刺激。然而：(1) 原發性血小板釋放障礙為出血性疾病，使用抗凝劑存在加重出血的明確安全疑慮；(2) 此類疾病本質為血小板顆粒缺陷，非凝血酶過度活化所致；機轉方向相悖，臨床應用邏輯不成立。

literature.title: Glanzmann thrombasthenia complicated by frequent myeloproliferative neoplasm-related thromboembolism: thrombosis occurring regardless of αIIbβIII integrin deficiency.
literature.abstract: A patient with Glanzmann Thrombasthenia developed recurrent venous thrombosis with a JAK2 positive myeloproliferative neoplasm. This indicates that the platelet aIIbβIII integrin has no role in venous thrombosis. We discuss the other potential mechanisms that are involved. In addition, we describe the successful use of dabigatran in this patient.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: GT 為 GPIIb/IIIa（整合素 αIIbβ3）雙等位基因突變導致血小板聚集完全失能，為嚴重出血性疾病。Dabigatran 抑制凝血酶理論上可減少 PAR-1/PAR-4 誘發的血小板活化刺激，但此無法修正 GPIIb/IIIa 缺陷，且對已無法聚集的血小板使用抗凝劑將顯著加重出血風險。唯一例外情境：GT 患者發生血栓合併症時的抗凝管理（見 PMID 34552732），但此為「合併症治療」而非 GT 再利用。

literature.title: Direct-Acting Oral Anticoagulant Dabigatran as a Bridging Therapy while Optimizing Warfarin Dosage for Cardioembolic Stroke.
literature.abstract: Parenteral heparin is widely used as bridging therapy while optimizing oral anticoagulation (OAC). Newer direct-acting OACs (DOACs) attain therapeutic effect very quickly. We report the use of dabigatran as bridging therapy during warfarin optimization for cardioembolic stroke in two patients who opted to receive warfarin for long-term anticoagulation for secondary stroke prevention.

literature.title: Use of dabigatran with antiretrovirals.
literature.abstract: Theoretical and untested interactions between antiretrovirals and direct-acting oral anticoagulants have limited the use of this new class of anticoagulant in people with HIV infection. This case series, the first of its kind, reports on the successful concurrent use of the direct-acting oral anticoagulant dabigatran and antiretroviral therapy.
